lines.speaker: Marco
lines.text: The river in front of us is flowing, right?

lines.speaker: Marco
lines.text: But where is this river flowing to?

lines.speaker: Marco
lines.text: Yeah, I know, they taught us that at school too. Martinetti, second year.

lines.speaker: Marco
lines.text: But they never taught us what happens to the river once it reaches the sea.

lines.speaker: Marco
lines.text: Like, does it just disappear and they become one?

lines.speaker: Marco
lines.text: Or maybe it stays where it is, goes into the sea without ever really merging with it?

lines.speaker: Marco
lines.text: Because if they don't merge, then it should still be flowing, right?

lines.speaker: Marco
lines.text: And where would it flow then?

lines.speaker: Marco
lines.text: I mean, all seas are really the same sea anyway. We're the ones who put different names on them on maps.
